name: Tama County, IA
findings: Tama County has 78 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tama County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Tama County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
